description: Status for an 11-digit census tract GEOID. A 2010 GEOID is checked against the 2018 designations and a 2020 GEOID against the 2027 round; many GEOIDs exist in both vintages. If you already geocoded a property, pass geoid_2010 and geoid_2020 instead of geoid.
